annotations.title: Edit an item in a review

description: Change one item in a review: its title, its comment, its position, or (for a screenshot) crop it. `crop` is {x, y, w, h} in fractions 0 to 1 of the current image; cropping removes the item's pins and shapes, since their positions were relative to the old image. `move_to` is the new 1-based position. Fields you leave out are unchanged.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (or the owner's agent token).

comment.description: New comment text, replacing the old one.

crop.description: Crop rectangle in fractions of the image.

item.description: 1-based position of the item in the review, as get_review numbers them.

name: edit_item
